meta.promptText: Which brand's kurta sets should I buy for women online in India?

response.text:
If you’re buying **women’s kurta sets online in India**, these are the brands I’d shortlist:

| Brand | Best for | Typical budget |
|---|---|---:|
| **BIBA** | Best overall; everyday + festive | ₹1,200–₹4,500 |
| **W for Woman** | Office wear, polished styles | ₹1,500–₹5,000 |
| **Aurelia** | Comfortable everyday/office sets | ₹900–₹4,000 |
| **Libas** | Trendy designs + good value | ₹700–₹2,500 |
| **Fabindia** | Cotton, traditional/artisanal look | ₹2,000+ |
| **Rangriti** | Affordable everyday ethnic wear | ₹800–₹2,500 |
| **Soch** | Dressier/festive sets | ₹1,500–₹5,000 |


A recent hands-on comparison found **W** strongest for polished versatility, **BIBA** particularly good for breathable everyday cotton, **Aurelia** for dressier occasions, and **Fabindia** for timeless/artisanal styles. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/i-tried-kurta-sets-from-w-fabindia-aurelia-biba-and-lakshita-here-s-which-ones-actually-feel-worth-the-money-101778651587378-amp.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/i-tried-kurta-sets-from-w-fabindia-aurelia-biba-and-lakshita-here-s-which-ones-actually-feel-worth-the-money-101778651587378.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My picks for you

**🥇 BIBA — safest all-round choice**  
If you want one brand to start with, I'd choose BIBA. Its current range has everything from cotton printed sets to embroidered and Anarkali styles. [www.biba.in](https://www.biba.in/kurta-sets/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### [Biba Women's Floral Print Straight Kurta Set]()
*₹2,159*

**💰 Libas — best value for money**  
Great if you want fashionable prints and complete sets without spending too much. Current examples include sets around ₹1,879–₹2,519. 

### [Libas Pink Embroidered Straight Suit Set with Dupatta]()
*₹1,879*

**🌸 Aurelia — best for comfortable, feminine everyday wear**

### [Aurelia Women's Printed Regular Fit Kurta Set]()
*₹2,299*

**👩‍💼 W for Woman — best for office/formal wear**  
Especially good if you prefer straight-cut silhouettes, subtle embroidery and a more sophisticated look. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/i-tried-kurta-sets-from-w-fabindia-aurelia-biba-and-lakshita-here-s-which-ones-actually-feel-worth-the-money-101778651587378-amp.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/i-tried-kurta-sets-from-w-fabindia-aurelia-biba-and-lakshita-here-s-which-ones-actually-feel-worth-the-money-101778651587378.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**My ranking:** **BIBA > W > Aurelia > Libas > Fabindia** for overall quality/style, while **Libas** wins if keeping the price low is the priority.

If you tell me your **budget (e.g. under ₹1,500 / ₹2,500 / ₹5,000), age range, size, and whether you want daily, office or festive wear**, I can narrow it down to **5–10 specific kurta sets worth buying right now**.
